description: Calibration fixture for measuring resolver hit rate + precision. Per the plan's §Calibration section: estimates in SKILL.md should be replaced with measured numbers once a labeled set of real targets is built. The committed rows are EXAMPLE/synthetic archetype shapes (null ground truth, no measurement value); the measured N>=25 real set lives ONLY in the gitignored local override.
notes_for_user: Ground-truth emails are intentionally null in the committed fixture (this repo is public — don't commit other people's addresses). Add your own targets and their known emails in `tests/fixtures/calibration_targets.local.json` (gitignored). The measurement harness merges the public fixture with the local overrides. Retention: local ground-truth entries are deleted on the subject's request — remove their row from the local override.

targets.name: EXAMPLE Sales Manager
targets.note: Replace with a real non-developer target locally — sales/recruiting personas test whether the pipeline degrades gracefully for the not-on-GitHub majority.

targets.name: Étienne Dupont
targets.note: Validates the normalize.py accent-folding path: etienne.dupont@... should pattern-generate.

targets.name: Wang Xiaoming
targets.note: Validates Eastern-order reversal: both wang.xiaoming@ and xiaoming.wang@ should appear as candidates.

targets.name: EXAMPLE Founder
targets.note: Replace with a real founder on a Google-Workspace tenant. The hard case SMTP can't crack: run with --allow-google-account and measure whether the Google People API + name_match disambiguates where SMTP returns inconclusive. Set handles.hn to test the HN sensor on this population.

targets.name: EXAMPLE Enterprise Contact
targets.note: Replace with a real contact on a Microsoft 365 tenant (MX = mail.protection.outlook.com). The current gap: SMTP returns inconclusive and there's no M365 existence probe wired, so this measures the floor — does the pipeline degrade honestly to pattern-guess + channel hints? See docs/plans/2026-06-11-m365-spike.md.

targets.name: EXAMPLE HN Founder
targets.note: Identity-engine archetype: the HN handle is an untrusted hint, but an address on the employer domain BINDS via employer_match (ENG-8) so it can be Google-probed. Measures whether HN-only addresses are correctly left unbound.

targets.name: EXAMPLE Indieweb Dev
targets.note: Identity-engine archetype: a personal_site mailbox on a bidirectionally rel=me-verified domain BINDS (anchored observation + rel=me ownership = 2 signals, ENG-8). Measures the rel_me sensor + the binding gate together.

targets.name: EXAMPLE Common Name
targets.note: Identity-engine archetype: a common name that should resolve to ambiguity=multiple_plausible_matches (the mechanical Tier-2 trigger). Measures whether the pipeline ABSTAINS — no bound candidate, no probe — rather than attributing a namesake's address.

targets.name: EXAMPLE Privacy Dev
targets.note: Identity-engine archetype: an address corroborated by a keys.openpgp.org owner-UID (E3). Measures that PGP is treated as deliverability-axis corroboration (pairs with another signal to bind), never identity-binding by itself (ENG-6).

targets.name: EXAMPLE OSS Maintainer
targets.note: Identity-engine archetype: a publisher email off a PyPI/npm package the person authored (near-100% precision when present). Measures the package_registry sensor.
